name: spartrak/module-customer-account
description: Read-side services for the SpareTrak My Account section (Figma 562:10229 / 562:17527 / 562:18126 / 562:18903): the sidebar's order-count badge, the four-step order tracker, and the per-order facts the account templates render. Presentation lives in the Spartrak theme; this module only answers questions about a customer's own data.
comment-require: Spartrak_Shipping and Spartrak_PickupLocation are also required at runtime, and are declared in etc/module.xml. They are NOT listed above because neither ships a composer.json in this checkout - they are app/code modules registered by registration.php - so naming them here would be an unresolvable package requirement rather than a real one. Load order is what actually matters and module.xml is where Magento reads it.
